spec: Indexed Fibonacci heap for the GrowthPass boundary (Lemma 3.3): insert/decrease/extract-min with cut and cascading cut, size = number of distinct ids present, O(1) discard that starts a fresh membership generation, degree array of size 3+2*ceil(log2(capacity+1)), invariant validator including the Fibonacci subtree-size bound
paper_ref: Sec 3.2, Lemma 3.3; Algorithm 1 line 5 (fresh heap per growth)

paper FibHeap marks on the first child loss and cuts on the second
paper FibHeap size counts distinct ids
paper FibHeap discard releases every entry and starts a fresh generation
paper FibHeap degree array has the size 3 + 2 ceil(log2(s + 1)) of Lemma 3.3
paper FibHeap orders composite keys lexicographically
paper FibHeap matches an ordered-set model under random operations with discards
